basic_details.job_title: District Court Pathanamthitta LD Typist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 62 years. Candidates must not have completed 62 years of age, and retirement must have occurred upon attaining 62 years of age.

qualification.details: Applicants who apply for the LD Typist post or higher posts must be persons who have retired from Kerala Judicial Ministerial Service, Kerala Judicial Ministerial Service-equivalent departments, or other government departments. Preference shall be given to persons who have retired from Kerala Judicial Ministerial Service.

selection_process: The selection process consists of application screening
followed by signing the contract agreement before the District Judge in the prescribed format upon receiving appointment.
how_to_apply: Prepare an application on white paper matching the prescribed format provided in the notification.
Affix a passport-size photo on the application.
Gather copies of certificates proving age, qualifications, experience, and identity.
Submit the completed application in person or by post to the District Court Office, Pathanamthitta.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 12 October 2026, at or before 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: The contract appointment is for a fixed period of 179 days only. Applicants must not have completed 62 years of age. Applications must be submitted in person or by post to the District Court Office. The closing date for receipt of applications is 12 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. Selected candidates must sign a contract agreement in the prescribed format before the District Judge. Preference is given to retired personnel from the Kerala Judicial Ministerial Service. Self-attested or verified copies of documents must be enclosed with the application.
